latest.title: Karpenter + ARC Zonal Shift on Amazon EKS
latest.description:
On May 12, 2026, AWS announced that Karpenter now supports ARC zonal shift for EKS clusters. When an AZ is impaired, Karpenter stops provisioning there and prevents voluntary disruptions — workloads concentrate in healthy zones.

This article walks through enabling the feature, triggering a zonal shift, and observing Karpenter's behavior under two different scheduling strategies.

latest.title: AWS Builder Center para iniciantes: o que eu gostaria de saber antes
latest.description:
Quando a gente começa na área de tecnologia, uma das maiores dificuldades não é só aprender uma linguagem, uma ferramenta ou um conceito novo. O mais difícil, muitas vezes, é entender por onde começar.

Eu curso Ciência da Computação e, mesmo estando no meio universitário, sei como é comum sentir que existe informação demais e direção de menos. Cloud computing, inteligência artificial, desenvolvimento, infraestrutura, certificações, projetos, carreira… tudo parece importante ao mesmo tempo.

latest.title: Understanding AutoGrad in PyTorch and Its Role in WGAN
latest.description: Training neural networks feels simple until you ask: what actually happens behind loss.backward()? While implementing WGAN-GP, I explored PyTorch AutoGrad, computation graphs, requires_grad, torch.autograd.grad(), torch.ones_like(), and gradient flow in depth. Wrote a practical deep dive connecting AutoGrad to WGAN-GP.

latest.description: I tested three supply-chain attacks against my own MCP-connected agents. The model was never jailbroken — the tools did the damage. Here's how AgentCore Gateway, Cedar policies, and Bedrock Guardrails make unsafe actions architecturally impossible.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: NeuroVoice
trending.description: Small moments, repeated daily, reveal what single snapshots never can - patterns that quietly signal neurological risk. NeuroVoice is a multimodal Parkinson’s screening platform that tracks pattern over time to detect subtle neurological changes early.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: Global Impact AI Navigator
trending.description: Global Impact AI Navigator (GIAN) is a multi-agent AI platform built on Amazon Bedrock that transforms a raw idea into a complete strategic package in under 60 seconds — SWOT diagnostic, live-grounded funding discovery, personalized roadmap, and a context-aware advisor. Designed for innovators in emerging markets, it democratizes access to the strategic guidance that usually requires expensive consultants or elite networks.
